description: Hello Friends! My name is Rachel Roarx. I live in the Parkwood Neighborhood with my husband Derrick Davis. We are lifelong Southend residents and high school sweethearts. I decided to run to become State Representative for the new Kentucky House District 38 because I am a strong voice for our union workers, women, and asset-based community development, focusing on taking pride in our South Louisville area.

title: Rachel Roarx for Kentucky 38
